correctness.rationale: The exact factorization and multiplicative sigma formula establish \(\sigma(174592)=392832=2\cdot174592+43648\) with 43648 a proper divisor. Nine explicitly listed complementary divisor pairs consist of distinct divisors and sum to \(349184=2\cdot174592\). An exact sigma sieve for every \(2\le n\le174592\) gives precisely 37 near-perfect candidates; an exhaustive subset-sum bitset over all complementary-divisor orbits for each candidate returns exactly [174592]. The independent divisor traversal cross-checks the sigma sieve at every near-perfect candidate. The fully included checker was run from its actual saved package path; no probabilistic or infinite extrapolation is used.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Equivalence is made explicit: near-perfectness iff \(\sigma(n)=2n+e\) for one proper divisor; strong pseudoperfectness iff the subset sum of all complementary-divisor orbit weights equals \(2n\). Neither individual definition implies the other; their intersection is the source question, and the present nine-orbit certificate supplies the missing logical conjunction.
